sentences.zh: 而你说这创造了一个更猛烈、更具破坏性的飓风。

sentences.en: And you're saying that creates a more violent and destructive hurricane.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想你理解了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think you got it.
sentences.zh: 我会把你的气象学证书寄给你。

sentences.en: I'll send you your meteorology certificate in the mail.
sentences.zh: 我只是在复述你刚才说的话。

sentences.en: I'm just repeating back what you said.
sentences.zh: 我只是在复述你刚才说的话。

sentences.en: But there have been this extraordinary string of storms passing through the Caribbean in the matter of just a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 但在短短几周内，加勒比地区经历了一连串非同寻常的风暴。

sentences.en: One after the other after the other.
sentences.zh: 接二连三，没完没了。

sentences.en: Is that a pattern?
sentences.zh: 这是一种规律吗？

sentences.en: Or is that a coincidence?
sentences.zh: 还是纯属巧合？

sentences.en: The fact that we got a lot of hurricanes is probably bad luck.
sentences.zh: 我们遭遇这么多飓风，大概只是运气不好。

sentences.en: Like, future research may prove me wrong, but I think that there's no strong argument to be made just based on physics that we're going to get more hurricanes.
sentences.zh: 未来的研究或许会证明我是错的，但我认为，单从物理学角度来看，并没有强有力的证据表明飓风会变得更多。

sentences.en: I think that most of the physical arguments tell us that you'll get probably about the same number of hurricanes, but the hurricanes will be stronger.
sentences.zh: 我认为大多数物理学论点告诉我们，飓风的数量可能差不多，但强度会更大。

sentences.en: Rebuilding Barbuda is not a task we can undertake alone.
sentences.zh: 重建巴布达岛不是我们单凭一己之力就能完成的任务。

sentences.en: What is the governor of Antigua and Barbuda asking his fellow countries at the UN for?
sentences.zh: 安提瓜和巴布达的总理在联合国向其他国家寻求什么？

sentences.en: You know, explicitly they're asking for aid.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们明确要求的是援助。

sentences.en: Preliminary estimates put the cost at some $300 million.
sentences.zh: 初步估计损失约为3亿美元。

sentences.en: That figure represents more than 20% of our GDP.
sentences.zh: 这个数字占我们国内生产总值的20%以上。

sentences.en: He laid out the extraordinary damage that Barbuda in particular faced.
sentences.zh: 他详细阐述了巴布达岛所面临的非同寻常的破坏。

sentences.en: Something like 98% of all infrastructure destroyed homes, cars, schools, hospitals.
sentences.zh: 大约98%的基础设施被毁，包括房屋、汽车、学校和医院。

sentences.en: And then on top of that, the entire population of Barbuda had to be evacuated, some 1,400 people, onto the island of Antigua.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，巴布达岛的全体居民，约1400人，不得不撤离到安提瓜岛。

sentences.en: The entire society has been plucked out of their homeland, from their property, from everything that defines them as a people.
sentences.zh: 整个社会被连根拔起，离开了家园，失去了财产，失去了定义他们作为一个民族的一切。

sentences.en: Behind the scenes, what they're asking for is a way to deal with climate change.
sentences.zh: 在幕后，他们寻求的是应对气候变化的方法。

sentences.en: And that has been so controversial within the UN climate negotiations.
sentences.zh: 这在联合国气候谈判中一直极具争议。

sentences.en: Because fundamentally what they're saying is, you, industrialized nations that have been emitting carbon dioxide for decades,
sentences.zh: 因为从根本上讲，他们说的是：你们这些几十年来一直在排放二氧化碳的工业化国家，

sentences.en: that is coming home to roost in our countries right now, and we need help.
sentences.zh: 现在恶果已经降临到我们国家了，我们需要帮助。

sentences.en: Today, I ask how your governments will respond to this humanitarian crisis.
sentences.zh: 今天，我询问你们的政府将如何应对这场人道主义危机。

sentences.en: We ask the international community to help us.
sentences.zh: 我们请求国际社会帮助我们。

sentences.en: Not because we want to outstretch a begging bowl, but because forces far beyond our control have pushed us to this dire situation.
sentences.zh: 不是因为我们想伸出乞讨的碗，而是因为远超我们控制的力量将我们推向了这种绝境。

sentences.en: They want the international community to think a little differently about how it has traditionally provided aid.
sentences.zh: 他们希望国际社会对传统的援助方式进行一些反思。

sentences.en: Some sort of funding mechanism that will specifically assist them in what they describe as planning for or dealing with the consequences of climate change that they can't prepare for,
sentences.zh: 他们需要某种资金机制，专门协助他们应对那些他们无法预见、无法适应的气候变化后果，

sentences.en: that they can't adapt to.
sentences.zh: 那些他们无法适应的后果。

sentences.en: They need help when they need to relocate, for example, an entire population of people, or when they need to rebuild an entire nation.
sentences.zh: 例如，当他们需要迁移整个人口，或者需要重建整个国家时，他们需要帮助。

sentences.en: I spoke with Walter Alfonso-Webson.
sentences.zh: 我采访了沃尔特·阿方索-韦布森。

sentences.en: He is the ambassador to the United Nations from Antigua and Barbuda.
sentences.zh: 他是安提瓜和巴布达驻联合国大使。

sentences.en: And he told me that his country is seeing the first climate migrants.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他的国家正在见证第一批气候难民。

sentences.en: He said, we talk about displaced persons from war.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们谈论的是战争造成的流离失所者。

sentences.en: My country is seeing the first displaced persons from climate change.
sentences.zh: 我的国家正在见证第一批因气候变化而流离失所的人。

sentences.en: Mr. President, my government invites governments, international financial institutions, and developmental agencies to help us in this virtuous and vital cause.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，我国政府邀请各国政府、国际金融机构和发展机构帮助我们完成这一崇高而重要的事业。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: These talks are happening on the heels of a storm that has just devastated these island nations.
sentences.zh: 这些会谈是在一场刚刚摧毁了这些岛国的风暴之后进行的。

sentences.en: Does that give this a whole new sense of urgency?
sentences.zh: 这是否赋予了此事一种全新的紧迫感？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: These hurricanes are making the issue visceral and immediate for islands.
sentences.zh: 这些飓风让岛屿国家切身感受到了问题的紧迫性。

sentences.en: And, you know, a lot of people are hoping that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，很多人希望美国，

sentences.en: in particular will recognize that other countries don't have the means to cope the way wealthy countries do.
sentences.zh: 特别是美国，能认识到其他国家没有富裕国家那样的应对手段。

sentences.en: You know, they argue that islands are some of the least responsible for causing climate change, but they are seeing some of the worst impacts.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们认为岛屿国家对气候变化负有的责任最小，但却承受着最严重的冲击。

sentences.en: One diplomat this week said to me, you know, if Harvey and Irma don't make the case for climate change, I don't know what will.
sentences.zh: 本周一位外交官对我说，如果“哈维”和“艾尔玛”飓风都不能证明气候变化的问题，我不知道还有什么能证明。

sentences.en: He said, you know, I think islands will probably say if this doesn't make the case for loss and damage, I don't know what will.
sentences.zh: 他说，我想岛屿国家大概会说，如果这都不能证明损失和损害的问题，我不知道还有什么能证明。

sentences.en: The entire country has been decimated.
sentences.zh: 整个国家都被摧毁了。

sentences.en: I have never seen anything like this before.
sentences.zh: 我从未见过这样的景象。

sentences.en: However, I want to say to you that you have to remain hopeful.
sentences.zh: 然而，我想对你说，你必须保持希望。

sentences.en: You have to remain resilient.
sentences.zh: 你必须保持韧性。

sentences.en: You have to remain strong.
sentences.zh: 你必须保持坚强。

sentences.en: And what I can assure you is that the government will stand full square with each Barbuda.
sentences.zh: 我可以向你保证，政府将全力支持每一位巴布达人。

sentences.en: Can I ask you one more question?
sentences.zh: 我能再问你一个问题吗？

sentences.en: Do people on these islands hold countries like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些岛上的人们是否认为像美国这样的国家，

sentences.en: responsible for creating the kind of climate change that makes these hurricanes worse and leads to greater destruction when they arrive on the islands?
sentences.zh: 应对造成气候变化负有责任，正是这种气候变化导致飓风加剧，并在抵达岛屿时造成更大的破坏？

sentences.en: The culture is such that we don't think that it's worth our while to hold a grudge against the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们的文化决定了我们认为对美国或任何人怀恨在心是不值得的。

sentences.en: or anybody else.
sentences.zh: 或者对任何人。

sentences.en: We're too small to make that difference anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正我们太小了，改变不了什么。

sentences.en: I mean, what can we do?
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们能做什么？

sentences.en: Basically, our country was hit by what would be a nuclear bomb that was created by developed countries.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我们的国家遭受了由发达国家制造的“核弹”般的打击。

sentences.en: And we can't do anything.
sentences.zh: 而我们无能为力。

sentences.en: We can go to the UN and say what we have to say.
sentences.zh: 我们可以去联合国说我们必须说的话。

sentences.en: So what do we do as a country?
sentences.zh: 那么作为一个国家，我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: We pray.
sentences.zh: 我们祈祷。

sentences.en: And we are God-fearing people.
sentences.zh: 我们是敬畏上帝的人民。

sentences.en: We believe in forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 我们相信宽恕。

sentences.en: And we believe in praying.
sentences.zh: 我们相信祈祷。

sentences.en: And we believe that God is willing to see it on our behalf.
sentences.zh: 我们相信上帝愿意代表我们去审视这一切。

sentences.en: And I'm telling you, prayer is powerful.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，祈祷是有力量的。

sentences.en: So do you think that any progress was made at the UN on this issue?
sentences.zh: 那么你认为在联合国就这个问题取得了任何进展吗？

sentences.en: I mean, it sounds like you don't think that a small country can make big countries change their behavior.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听起来你认为小国无法让大国改变行为。

sentences.en: But from what you can tell, has this message been heard at the UN?
sentences.zh: 但据你所知，这个信息在联合国被听到了吗？

sentences.en: And do you think things could change?
sentences.zh: 你认为事情会有所改变吗？

sentences.en: You know, one of the parts about the history of Antigua and Barbuda that you didn't talk about is that we were one slave.
sentences.zh: 你知道，关于安提瓜和巴布达的历史，你没提到的一点是，我们曾是奴隶。

sentences.en: And slavery was not abolished because we shouted and we tried to rebel and we spoke to our slave masters anyway.
sentences.zh: 奴隶制的废除并不是因为我们大声疾呼、试图反抗，或者与奴隶主交涉。

sentences.en: Slavery was abolished because the economics of slavery was just too expensive.
sentences.zh: 奴隶制的废除是因为奴隶制的经济成本太高了。

sentences.en: They just made it not worth it.
sentences.zh: 他们只是觉得这不划算。

sentences.en: It wasn't abolished because they were being nice and they were being kind.
sentences.zh: 它之所以被废除，并不是因为他们变得善良或仁慈。

sentences.en: It was because the economics is so bad.
sentences.zh: 而是因为经济账算不过来。

sentences.en: So climate change is not going to have a response from the larger countries who are the ones who control capital.
sentences.zh: 所以，对于气候变化，那些控制资本的大国不会有回应。

sentences.en: So they have to take the lead.
sentences.zh: 所以他们必须带头。

sentences.en: Until the cost and the impact of climate change is going to become too expensive.
sentences.zh: 直到气候变化的成本和影响变得过于昂贵。

sentences.en: So what you're saying is that you may have to wait for a moment when the damage of climate change is inflicted upon the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，你们可能必须等到气候变化造成的损害降临到美国身上，

sentences.en: in the same way that it has been inflicted on the island where you live.
sentences.zh: 就像它降临到你们居住的岛屿上那样。

sentences.en: Is there a scenario, and I'm sure this is hard to be asked,
sentences.zh: 有没有一种情况——我知道这个问题很难回答——

sentences.en: but is there a scenario that ever could play out in your mind where you fear that your nation could be essentially uninhabitable?
sentences.zh: 在你心中，是否曾设想过你的国家最终变得无法居住？

sentences.en: And people will decide that it's just not worth living there.
sentences.zh: 人们会觉得那里根本不值得居住。

sentences.en: Storm after storm, geographically where you are, and the reality that these storms are worse and maybe getting even more devastating.
sentences.zh: 风暴接二连三，考虑到你们的地理位置，以及这些风暴正在变得更糟、甚至可能更具破坏性的现实。

sentences.en: It's not the hurricanes that's going to drive us out of our island.
sentences.zh: 把我们赶出岛屿的不会是飓风。

sentences.en: It is sea level rise.
sentences.zh: 而是海平面上升。

sentences.en: And it is sea level rise that's going to destroy Barbuda.
sentences.zh: 正是海平面上升将摧毁巴布达。

sentences.en: The sea level rise that will destroy the coastline in Antifa.
sentences.zh: 海平面上升将摧毁安提瓜的海岸线。

sentences.en: And that is something that has been predicted to happen in the next 30 to 50 years.
sentences.zh: 这是预测在未来30到50年内会发生的事情。

sentences.en: But we're already seeing the impact right now.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在已经看到了影响。

sentences.en: So it is sea level rise that is going to take out half of the state of Florida.
sentences.zh: 所以，海平面上升将吞没佛罗里达州的一半。

sentences.en: It is sea level rise that's going to take out the coastline of most of the islands in the region.
sentences.zh: 海平面上升将吞没该地区大多数岛屿的海岸线。

sentences.en: Why not just leave the island?
sentences.zh: 为什么不直接离开岛屿呢？

sentences.en: And by you, I mean, just about everybody there.
sentences.zh: 我说的“你们”，是指那里的几乎所有人。

sentences.en: If you can start to see the writing on the wall.
sentences.zh: 如果你们已经预见到大难临头。

sentences.en: And go where?
sentences.zh: 去哪里呢？

sentences.en: To say that we want to pick up and leave our beautiful islands and our homes is not what we want.
sentences.zh: 说我们想收拾行李离开我们美丽的岛屿和家园，这并非我们的本意。

sentences.en: So do you plan to stay?
sentences.zh: 那你打算留下来吗？

sentences.en: I plan to stay, yes.
sentences.zh: 我打算留下来，是的。

sentences.en: Where are you going to go?
sentences.zh: 你要去哪里？

sentences.en: Diane, I really want to thank you.
sentences.zh: 黛安，我真的非常感谢你。

sentences.en: And I wish you the beSt.
sentences.zh: 祝你一切顺利。

sentences.en: And everybody in Antigua and Barbuda.
sentences.zh: 也祝安提瓜和巴布达的所有人一切顺利。

sentences.en: And thank you very much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的时间。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: On Thursday night, after Hurricane Maria struck Puerto Rico and knocked out power to the entire island,
sentences.zh: 周四晚上，在飓风“玛丽亚”袭击波多黎各并导致全岛断电后，

sentences.en: the Prime Minister of Antigua and Barbuda, Gaston Alfonso Brown, arrived at the UN General Assembly to make his own plea on behalf of his country for help after Hurricane Irma.
sentences.zh: 安提瓜和巴布达总理加斯顿·阿方索·布朗抵达联合国大会，代表他的国家就飓风“艾尔玛”过后的援助发出呼吁。

sentences.en: For the first time in 300 years, Brown said, there is no permanent resident of Barbuda.
sentences.zh: 布朗说，300年来第一次，巴布达岛上没有了常住居民。

sentences.en: Everything that meant anything to the inhabitants had to be left behind, he added.
sentences.zh: 他补充说，对居民们来说意味着一切的东西都不得不被抛弃。

sentences.en: Their homes, their possessions, their history.
sentences.zh: 他们的家园、财产和历史。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无保留、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在nytimes.com上免费直播部分采访，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他新闻。

sentences.en: A day after threatening to totally destroy North Korea during a speech at the United Nations,
sentences.zh: 在联合国发表演讲威胁要彻底摧毁朝鲜的一天后，

sentences.en: President Trump issued new sanctions that would force foreign countries, companies, and individuals to choose between doing business with North Korea and the United States.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统发布了新的制裁措施，迫使外国、外国公司和个人在与朝鲜做生意和与美国做生意之间做出选择。

sentences.en: In response, North Korea's dictator, Kim Jong-un, issued a statement calling President Trump a, quote,
sentences.zh: 作为回应，朝鲜领导人金正恩发表声明，称特朗普总统为，引述，

sentences.en: mentally deranged U.S.
sentences.zh: 精神错乱的美国，

sentences.en: dotard, describing his remarks at the U.N.
sentences.zh: 老糊涂，并称他在联合国的言论，

sentences.en: as unprecedented rude nonsense and vowing to tame Trump with fire.
sentences.zh: 是前所未有的粗鲁胡言乱语，并誓言要用火来驯服特朗普。

sentences.en: And, I care deeply about the democratic process and protecting its integrity.
sentences.zh: 而且，我非常关心民主进程并致力于保护其完整性。

sentences.en: I don't want anyone to use our tools to undermine democracy.
sentences.zh: 我不希望任何人利用我们的工具来破坏民主。

sentences.en: That's not what we stand for.
sentences.zh: 那不是我们的立场。

sentences.en: Facebook is turning over more than 3,000 ads linked to Russia to congressional committees investigating the Kremlin's interference in last year's election.
sentences.zh: Facebook正在向调查克里姆林宫干预去年大选的国会委员会移交3000多条与俄罗斯有关的广告。

sentences.en: The company is under growing pressure to reveal Russian propaganda on its site, including nearly 500 accounts that promoted inflammatory messages during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 该公司正面临越来越大的压力，要求其披露网站上的俄罗斯宣传内容，包括在竞选期间推广煽动性信息的近500个账户。

sentences.en: Now, I wish I could tell you that we're going to be able to stop all interference, but that just wouldn't be realistic.
sentences.zh: 现在，我希望我能告诉你们，我们将能够阻止所有的干预，但这不切实际。

sentences.en: In an online video, Facebook's founder, Mark Zuckerberg, said he would crack down on the Russian propaganda by changing how the company treats political ads,
sentences.zh: 在一段在线视频中，Facebook创始人马克·扎克伯格表示，他将通过改变公司处理政治广告的方式来打击俄罗斯的宣传，

sentences.en: working more closely with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 与美国政府更紧密地合作，

sentences.en: government, and investing more heavily in security systeMs.
sentences.zh: 并加大对安全系统的投入。

sentences.en: There will always be bad actors in the world, and we can't prevent all governments from all interference.
sentences.zh: 世界上总会有坏人，我们无法阻止所有政府的所有干预行为。

sentences.en: But we can make it harder.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以增加难度。

sentences.en: We can make it much harder.
sentences.zh: 我们可以让它变得困难得多。

sentences.en: And that's what we're going to focus on doing.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们将要专注去做的事情。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我，莎拉·凯尼格，将为您讲述那些试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的人们的故事。
